# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge
We pledge to make participation in our community a harassment-free experience
for everyone, regardless of background or identity.

## Our Standards
Be respectful, give and accept constructive feedback gracefully, and focus on
what's best for the community. Harassment, trolling, insults, and publishing
others' private information are not tolerated.

## Enforcement
Report unacceptable behavior privately via a GitHub Security Advisory or a
direct message to the maintainers. Reports are handled promptly and fairly.

Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), v2.1.
